Discovery of the cell and the cell theor: Hooke saw cork cells. The cell theory says all organisms are made of cells, the basic units of life.
Cell organelles: Each organelle has a function: the nucleus controls, mitochondria release energy, ribosomes make proteins and the Golgi packages materials.
Plant and animal cells, prokaryotes and: Plant cells have a wall, chloroplasts and a large vacuole. Prokaryotes lack a true nucleus.
Movement of substances across the cell m: Diffusion and osmosis move substances passively; active transport needs energy. Tonicity decides whether cells swell or shrink.
